narrative.incident_description: Vulnerability exposure: CVE-2023-22515 matches software on asset TEL-WIKI-01 (hostname noc-wiki-01, sector telecom). The installed Confluence version 8.5.1 falls within the vulnerable range (>=8.5.0, <8.5.2). The asset is internet-facing and simulated. No exploitation has been observed in the evidence.
recommended_next_actions: Confirm scope: verify the affected assets and whether the activity/exposure is real
Preserve relevant logs (CERT-In Directions require ICT system logs to be retained for 180 days)
Apply the vendor patch or mitigation, or restrict exposure until patched
Hunt for signs of exploitation; if found, reassess reportability (6-hour clock starts when noticed)
